Production Linux process environment and parsed OsString flag retain raw bytes; no shared test-process environment mutation.

Reach default and fallible configured GameServer, FleetAutoscaler, admission, and actual SDK environment consumers.

assurance: Ordinary implementation, downstream shared-provider composition and actual process/Rusternetes MemoryStorage configuration integration; no new source-property extraction or formal proof credited before this gate.

Parsed changed flag / explicit override context -> same CGP loader -> source-priority selection without environment read -> raw query parser -> fallible configured Rusternetes and SDK consumers.
